description: The small set of services claimseed scenarios draw from. Descriptions are written by claimseed in plain language and are NOT the AMA CPT descriptors; HCPCS Level II codes (G, J, Q) are public domain. Allowed amounts are national Medicare amounts for the stated year, taken from the public MPFS/CLFS files (scripts/fetch-reference-data.js, run on the maintainer's machine); each entry records its source and whether it was verified. scripts/check-release-ready.js refuses to publish examples built on unverified prices.
